units: 6 arbitrary horizontal units = 3 cells; not meters
axes: X right, Y rear, Z up, front -Y

poses.spin: only at 0 degree tilt, axis then equals world Z

sequence: hold inclined rest, spin stopped, arcs OFF
tilt carrier and rotor together to horizontal, spin stopped, arcs OFF
hold carrier horizontal, spin inner rotor, intermittent arcs inside aperture
when stopped return carrier to rest

arcs.appearance: short intermittent white-amber electric arcs between inner-rim contact points, confined to aperture
arcs.excluded: no portal, filled energy disc, weapon beam or gameplay damage
arcs.albedo: no emissive baked lightning; separate effect/material

cancelled: arcs OFF, decelerate rotor then return tilt to rest
idle: inclined rest; no spin or arcs
activation: not yet tied to a gameplay queue; building unlocks technology and has no production/research queue
timing: cycle lengths, rates, easing and trigger unapproved
validation: sampled tilt 0..45 by 3 degrees and spin 0..355 by 5 degrees; rotor remains within 3x3, above sealed roof and inside tower inner faces; final detailed bearings and clamps still require collision check
limitations: coarse guide, not final mesh, rig or effect
